gloss: to stand out from the crowd; to be outstanding

definitions.gloss: to stand out from the crowd; to be outstanding; to be head and shoulders above
definitions.explanation: To be exceptionally superior compared to others in a group. Literally means "to pull out from the herd/group." Used as high praise for someone or something far exceeding the norm.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}の{実力|じつりょく}は{群|ぐん}を{抜|ぬ}いている。
この{店|みせ}のラーメンは{群|ぐん}を{抜|ぬ}いておいしい。
examples.english: This shop's ramen is far and away the most delicious.

examples.japanese: {数多|かずおお}くの{応募者|おうぼしゃ}の{中|なか}で、{彼|かれ}のプレゼンテーションは{群|ぐん}を{抜|ぬ}いていた。
examples.english: Among the many applicants, his presentation was head and shoulders above the rest.

notes:
USAGE:
Most commonly used in the て-form as {群|ぐん}を{抜|ぬ}いて (outstandingly, far and above) or the ている-form {群|ぐん}を{抜|ぬ}いている (is outstanding). Often modifies adjectives: {群|ぐん}を{抜|ぬ}いて{高|たか}い (outstandingly high), {群|ぐん}を{抜|ぬ}いて{優|すぐ}れている (exceptionally excellent).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {群|ぐん}を{抜|ぬ}いた + noun ({群|ぐん}を{抜|ぬ}いた{才能|さいのう}, outstanding talent)
- {群|ぐん}を{抜|ぬ}いて + adjective ({群|ぐん}を{抜|ぬ}いて{美|うつく}しい, outstandingly beautiful)
- {群|ぐん}を{抜|ぬ}いている (is outstanding)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {抜群|ばつぐん}: Outstanding, preeminent — a na-adjective derived from the same concept. More compact and commonly used as a modifier: {抜群|ばつぐん}の{成績|せいせき} (outstanding grades).
- {際立|きわだ}つ: To stand out — emphasizes being conspicuously different, not necessarily superior.
